study.title: Video-based product concept testing of future maize hybrids, Uganda
study.description: Farmers watched short videos presenting three of the product concepts, assigned at random (incomplete block design), and named the concept they would most and least like to acquire. Part of 'Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) as a basis for groundnut, maize, and sorghum market segmentation' (CIMMYT market intelligence, v1.1, 2025-04-29). Donovan J, Rutsaert P, Mawia H, de Sousa K, van Etten J (2025). Farmers' preferences for the next generation of maize hybrids. Experimental Agriculture 61, e5. https://doi.org/10.1017/S001447972500002X Source data: Rutsaert P, Mawia H (2025). Using a Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) as a basis for maize market segmentation in Kenya and Uganda in 2022. CIMMYT Research Data & Software Repository Network, V1. https://doi.org/10.71682/10549312
study.objective: market segmentation and product profile design

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT)

genotypes.description: Meets the needs of the fresh green maize market. The variety combines a sweet taste with long cobs and good grain filling. This combination makes it a fitting variety for the fresh market. The remaining forage can be used for cattle feed.

It is suitable for early harvesting. Can harvest this variety after 3 and a half months or 110 days. Just remember that by harvesting early, you’ll get a lower yield than average for your farm. But you will reduce the danger of losing a harvest to drought

Provides both food needs as well as the needs of dairy animals such as cows.. Besides maize yield, the variety provides excellent fodder (from the stem and leaves of the plant) with high fiber content. This can be used as green fodder directly after harvest or dried and stored for later use.

Provides overall health and a key nutrient for young children. Has a bright orange color which comes from beta-carotene, a substance that can also be found in carrots. This variety is good for your overall health and tastes the same as white maize.

Focused on ensuring your family has enough maize to eat until your next harvest.. The quality of kernels allows household storage for up to 6 months without major losses due to rotting or weevil damage, without special storage bags or silos
Optimal performance when maize rows with are alternated with beans. Benefits from the wider spacing and gives bigger plants that often grow double cobs + need less fertilizer

This variety provides great feed for animals such as chicken and pigs. The variety has a very high nutritional value. This gives the maize a yellow color but makes it better than white maize for animal feed.

Resistance to some of the major stresses including drought, diseases and low soil fertility. Higher maize yield than your neighbors’ when there is little rain or when the diseases are present in the area.
